nehemiah.12.p1.b1.text: Now these are the priests and Levites who went up with Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and with Jeshua …

nehemiah.12.p1.b2.text: Jeshua was the father of Joiakim, Joiakim was the father of Eliashib, Eliashib was the father of Joiada … Jonathan was the father of Jaddua.

nehemiah.12.p1.b3.text: … who stood across from them to give praise and thanksgiving as one section alternated with the other, as prescribed by David the man of God.

nehemiah.12.p1.b4.text: They served in the days of Joiakim son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor and Ezra the priest and scribe.

nehemiah.12.p2.b1.text: At the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem, the Levites were sought out from all their homes and brought to Jerusalem to celebrate the joyous dedication with thanksgiving and singing, accompanied by cymbals, harps, and lyres.

nehemiah.12.p2.b2.text: … for they had built villages for themselves around Jerusalem.

nehemiah.12.p2.b3.text: After the priests and Levites had purified themselves, they purified the people, the gates, and the wall.

nehemiah.12.p3.b1.text: Then I brought the leaders of Judah up on the wall, and I appointed two great thanksgiving choirs …

nehemiah.12.p3.b2.text: One was to proceed along the top of the wall to the right, toward the Dung Gate … Ezra the scribe led the procession.

nehemiah.12.p3.b3.text: and some of the priests with trumpets …

nehemiah.12.p3.b4.text: At the Fountain Gate they climbed the steps of the City of David on the ascent to the wall … to the Water Gate on the east.

nehemiah.12.p4.b1.text: The second thanksgiving choir proceeded to the left …

nehemiah.12.p4.b2.text: … and I followed it with half the people along the top of the wall, past the Tower of the Ovens … as far as the Sheep Gate. And they stopped at the Gate of the Guard.

nehemiah.12.p4.b3.text: The two thanksgiving choirs then stood in the house of God, as did I, along with the half of the officials accompanying me …

nehemiah.12.p4.b4.text: … Then the choirs sang out under the direction of Jezrahiah.

nehemiah.12.p4.b5.text: On that day they offered great sacrifices, rejoicing because God had given them great joy. The women and children also rejoiced …

nehemiah.12.p4.b6.text: … so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard from afar.

nehemiah.12.p5.b1.text: And on that same day men were appointed over the rooms that housed the supplies, contributions, firstfruits, and tithes …

nehemiah.12.p5.b2.text: … because Judah rejoiced over the priests and Levites who were serving.

nehemiah.12.p5.b3.text: … along with the singers and gatekeepers, as David and his son Solomon had prescribed.

nehemiah.12.p5.b4.text: So in the days of Zerubbabel and Nehemiah, all Israel contributed the daily portions for the singers and gatekeepers …
